nodes.label: Contract: AI agents API — MCP, REST, OAuth (v1)
AgentService shared service layer (MCP thin adapter)
nodes.rationale: MCP layer is a thin adapter so REST calls the same functions (R-13)

nodes.label: /mcp MCP server (Streamable HTTP, stateless)
nodes.rationale: Stateless handler: new server instance per request; 2025 clients served via SDK compat path

nodes.label: Origin check (DNS-rebinding protection)
nodes.rationale: Foreign Origin -> 403; no Origin (server clients) allowed

nodes.label: Notebook 'for agents' mode access rule (D-04)
nodes.rationale: Checked on every request so switching notebook to private instantly revokes access; trashed notes hidden

nodes.label: Permissions read / read_write and scopes notes:read, notes:write
Grant (static / oauth agent permission)
nodes.rationale: Revoking a grant immediately invalidates all its tokens

nodes.label: Token formats (dsa_, dso_at_, dso_rt_, dso_code_)
nodes.rationale: Only SHA-256 hashes stored; token only in Authorization Bearer header, never URL; refresh rotation

nodes.label: Client ID Metadata Documents (CIMD)
nodes.rationale: HTTPS only, public addresses only, <=64 KiB, 5 s timeout, 24 h cache; public clients only

nodes.label: Dynamic Client Registration (RFC 7591)
nodes.rationale: Kept for compatibility

nodes.label: Resource parameter (RFC 8707)
nodes.rationale: Defaults to <publicUrl>/mcp if client omits it

nodes.label: Errors before redirect_uri validation shown as page (open-redirect protection)
nodes.rationale: Prevents open redirect

nodes.label: OAuth consent screen ('Тихая бумага' server HTML page)
nodes.rationale: No JS, no external resources, CSP frame-ancestors 'none'; HMAC-signed form state 15 min; reauthorization updates the single grant per client

nodes.label: 401 WWW-Authenticate resource_metadata / insufficient_scope step-up
nodes.rationale: read-only OAuth agent calling write tool gets 403 insufficient_scope so client can step up; static tokens get tool error forbidden

nodes.label: Agents cannot create/rename/delete notebooks (E2E master key)
nodes.rationale: Notebook is encrypted with user's master key which the server does not have (E2E); stated in tool descriptions, MCP instructions and list_notebooks hint

nodes.label: Tool / REST error format (isError, error codes, model-oriented messages)
nodes.rationale: Messages written for the model: what is wrong and what to do

nodes.label: Agent Markdown dialect (read_note output)
nodes.rationale: Same dialect for reading and writing; Obsidian Tasks compatible task syntax

nodes.label: Handwriting group (one writing 'session', 2.5s pause, 1.5em gap)
nodes.rationale: Anchors only name the place; a word written across cells stays one group; handwritingId = earliest stroke id

nodes.label: Escaping and verbatim content (read_note round-trip)
nodes.rationale: read_note -> edit -> read_note must yield the same text; LaTeX and code taken verbatim

nodes.label: edit_note operations (insert, replace, delete, move, replace_text; atomic)
nodes.rationale: Atomic: any failing op changes nothing; replace keeps first blockId so comments and margin notes stay

nodes.label: Handwriting preservation on edits (replace_text minimal diff, move rewrites anchors)
nodes.rationale: replace_text changes only differing middle so Yjs items and stroke anchors survive; move copies block and rewrites anchors since Yjs cannot move items

nodes.label: agentEdit mark { agentId: grantId, at }
nodes.rationale: Highlights agent-inserted text in existing notes

nodes.label: Agent edit as Yjs update via context.data.applyUpdate (origin kind agent)
nodes.rationale: Server encrypts, assigns seq, keeps version history; rollback via version history

nodes.label: NoteMeta.createdByAgent (D-45)
nodes.rationale: New agent notes carry no agentEdit marks; provenance stored in NoteMeta

nodes.label: Folders and note moves (Folder records in notebook index)
nodes.rationale: No two same-named siblings (conflict with existing folderId); move_to_parent also moves trashed notes

nodes.label: Cross-notebook note move (key rewrap, single transaction)
nodes.rationale: All-or-nothing; note key rewrapped by target notebook key, history/handwriting/attachments unchanged; RLS checks both notebooks; daily notes and Inbox not movable

nodes.label: Handwriting PNG rendering (@napi-rs/canvas)
nodes.rationale: Bundled fonts (Inter, Newsreader, Noto Emoji) so output is identical on any machine; strokes never cropped

nodes.label: Handwritten shape preservation (free/scribble/arrow hints)
nodes.rationale: Letter widths and line breaks differ from editor; uses neighbor-point motion at anchor changes and places group in block system with most points

nodes.label: Audit log (AuditEntry)
nodes.rationale: Both successes and failures logged; audit write failure does not fail the operation

nodes.label: In-process rate limits (D-25): 120/min per grant, 30/min OAuth per IP
/v1/agent-tokens management endpoints
nodes.rationale: Lists both static and OAuth grants without secrets; implemented only in plugin

nodes.label: grantId parameter -> Row-Level Security role (D-30)
nodes.rationale: Every agent call passes grantId so server queries under RLS restricted to grant notebooks

nodes.label: context.data.moveNoteDoc
nodes.rationale: Optional; without it move_note works only within a notebook

nodes.label: context.store (grants, OAuth clients, codes, tokens, audit)
Notebook/space names duplicated in notebook doc meta
nodes.rationale: Server lacks names (E2E), so clients duplicate name/icon/space in notebook meta; fallback 'Без названия'
